Name: OMG - Our Manic Game
Description: A frantic collection of short manic challenges.

Achievements.Name: Close Combat
Achievements.Description: Get close to enemies to kill them.

Achievements.Name: Annoying
Achievements.Description: Touch all bosses in a game.

Achievements.Name: Rainbow Warrior
Achievements.Description: Improve your laser beam by defeating waves without dying.

Achievements.Name: Jackpot
Achievements.Description: Send enemies crazy then kill them as late as you can.

Achievements.Name: Cold Blood
Achievements.Description: Find a safe spot and stay idle.

Achievements.Name: Killing Spree
Achievements.Description: Shoot at enemies without killing them, then kill them all in a row.
